Onboarding läuft strukturiert vom unterschriebenen Vertrag bis Tag eins, Personio ist sauber gepflegt, Payroll-Schnittstelle läuft fehlerfrei.
Du hast mindestens eine personaladministrative Akquisitions-Integration durchgezogen — Vertragsharmonisierung, Personio-Migration, Comp-Anpassung, Payroll-Übernahme.
Du hast erste Automatisierungs-Schritte in der People-Operations-Schicht produktiv gemacht.

s.h: Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast
s.t:
Du hast mindestens drei personaladministrative Akquisitions-Integration abgeschlossen.
Die People-Operations-Workflows sind dokumentiert und automatisiert — neue Standorte und Hires werden schneller produktiv.
Du arbeitest sichtbar mit der Geschäftsführung an Comp-Bandlogik, Performance-Cycles und People-Compliance.

s.h: Was du nach 24 Monaten geliefert hast
s.t:
Die People-Operations-Schicht der Vogel-Gruppe trägt das Wachstum — Hires, Akquisitionen, Standorte werden personaladministrativ aufgenommen, ohne dass die Funktion linear mitwächst.
Du übernimmst erste fachliche Sparring-Aufgaben für jüngere People-Ops-Profile.
Du bist konkreter Kandidat für die Senior-People-Ops-Stufe.

Der nächste Schritt ist Senior People Operations Manager — Verantwortung für die gesamte People-Operations-Funktion über alle Standorte. Über die Senior-Stufe öffnet sich der Lead/Director-Pfad entlang unseres Career Frameworks.
Das bringst du mit
Erfahrung & Track Record
Du hast bestenfalls zwei bis vier Jahre als People Operations Manager, HR Operations Manager oder Senior HR Generalist bei einem Tech-Scaleup (Personio, Pleo, Celonis, Forto, vergleichbare Marken), einer Professional-Services-Firma oder einer mittelstandsnahen Service-Brand gearbeitet.
Du hast Personio (oder ein vergleichbares HRIS) operativ verantwortet und kennst die typischen Probleme im Detail.
Du kennst Ashby oder bist motiviert dich selbstständig einzuarbeiten.
Du hast mindestens einmal eine Vertrags-, Payroll- oder Comp-Migration in einer wachsenden oder akquirierenden Organisation begleitet.
Profile, die nicht in das obige Raster passen, aber substanzielle Operations-Tiefe mitbringen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen — wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Konkret: Operations-Profile aus Vertical SaaS mit People-Ops-Aufbau-Erfahrung; ehemalige Steuerfachangestellte mit Lohnbuchführungs-Tiefe und Wechsel in People Ops; juristische Profile (LL.M. Arbeitsrecht) mit operativem Hand und Wechsel aus Kanzlei in Inhouse-Funktion.
Skills & Arbeitsweise
Du arbeitest analytisch und strukturiert — eine Vertrags- oder Payroll-Harmonisierung über mehrere Gesellschaften ist ein Prozess, kein Bauchgefühl.
Du beherrschst Personio (oder ein vergleichbares HRIS) auf einem Niveau, das über Standardklicks hinausgeht — Workflows, Reports, Schnittstellen zur Payroll.
Du gehst sauber mit Payroll, Lohnabrechnung, sozialversicherungs- und lohnsteuerrechtlichen Themen um — nicht als juristische Tiefe, sondern als operative Sicherheit. Du kennst den Unterschied zwischen Brutto-Netto-Logik, Pauschalierungs-Mechaniken und Lohnsteuer-Anmeldungen.
Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug für Recherche, Drafting, Dokumentation und Workflow-Automation.
Du kommunizierst Compliance-, Vertrags- und Payroll-Fragen so, dass Geschäftsführung und Mitarbeitende sie verstehen und handeln können.

This is an exciting role where you will be responsible for supporting the operational side of the business, by providing a first-class HR service. You will work under the direction of the HR Manager, assisting with the execution of their duties in support of the organisations vision to become more streamlined and competitive.

Your main duties will include managing employee needs and ensuring all employees comply with company and government procedures. As an HR generalist you will perform daily administrative and human resources duties in the organisation assisting with the management of all employee aspects within the business.

This includes giving individual employees advice about the future of their careers, onboarding new employees, facilitating open communication between employees and management and leading workshops and training. You must be comfortable communicating with employees about sensitive subjects such as salary, pension and benefits.

Furthermore, you must be accustomed to using technology frequently as data entry is also an important component of your job as they are expected to update all employee records on the company’s database.

You will use various research skills to aid in the implementation of performance evaluation strategies and designing company policies in accordance with health and social care standards and other industry legislation.

As an HR generalist you will represent a company’s policies, procedures and goals, and many of your tasks revolve around instilling these values in employees, whilst making sure the policies are also fair to the employees.
Essential Job Functions
You will serve as a liaison between the human resources department and employees for effective communication and conflict resolution. You will be responsible for ensuring company needs are met while promoting our positive company culture policy. You will be expected to continuously learn the latest HR best practices to improve workplace efficiency.

Ensuring the smooth day to day running of all personnel-related systems, training and development and assisting in ensuring care inspectorate and home office worker compliance within department.

You will be professional and proactive ensuring that administration is carried out accurately and in timely manner to ensure the smooth running of the department.Keeping up to date with key changes in employment law.

You will work closely with various departments, increasingly in a consultancy role, assisting line managers to understand and implement policies and procedures
Employee Relations
Assist the HR manager in providing HR advice on a wide range of generalist issues, considering commercial and operational impact
Support manager with performance and sickness management and employee engagement
Working alongside the HR Manager and supporting them with any ER issues
Assist building, implementing, and maintaining a Performance Appraisal program that allows SMT to coherently evaluate performances across the Company.
Support HR Manager on all matters
Develop and implement policies on issues like working conditions, performance management, equal opportunities, disciplinary procedures and absence management
develop HR planning strategies, which consider immediate and long-term staff requirements
Contribute to the development of the strategic direction of the organisation and to work collaboratively across the business to help achieve corporate objectives and foster an atmosphere of mutual support
Establish and maintain appropriate systems for measuring necessary aspects of HR development including performance management and absence management
Supporting internal and external inquiries and requests related to the HR department assisting with the documentation of employee compensation and benefits
HR Management
Provide HR data analytics and reports
Support with HR projects and initiatives maintain vital employee records and ensure the smooth operation of the HR department.
Administration and collation of the payroll information including payroll queries
Overseeing HR events and meetings and coordinating management-employee communications
Compiling and maintaining paper, digital and electronic employee records, including holiday and sickness leaves
Writing and submitting reports on general HR activities
Absence Management
Upskilling and supporting managers to deal with absence management and supporting in short- and long-term absence cases.
Calculating annual leave entitlements and communicate this information to the respective Home Managers
Employee Engagement
Coming up with and implementing best in class strategies and initiatives to optimise employee engagement.
Training and Development
Administering tests and organising training for employees. Supporting HR-related training programs, workshops and seminars
Coordinating logistics for new hire orientations
Assisting managers in implementing training plans for staff and helping create career pathways for employees.
Monitor training due dates to ensure compliance with CI and internal requirements; book training and promptly escalate any overdue
Assist with training carried out in-house, liaising with attendees, preparing materials, room preparation, producing certificates plan and sometimes deliver training, including new staff inductions
Support with conducting the induction programmes for all new starters.
Assist for assessing, building and maintaining a succession planning program in accordance to the SMT and to the needs of the Company.
Assist with coordination of reviews and appraisals and keep appropriate documentation analyse training needs in conjunction with departmental managers.
Administration
Managing the Factorial HR system and Atlas Training Management ensuring data is accurately uploaded and systems are kept updated, equality commission reports are returned, handling employee queries in a timely manner and providing KPI information and reports to the HR Manager
Liaising with training providers and organising rooms for training events including refreshments
Responsibility for booking training courses, travel, and accommodation and responding to queries
Minute taking in various meeting throughout the organisations
Completing annual audits of the employee files
Requesting and maintaining all new IT accounts for new employees and ensuring old accounts are closed
Perform day-to-day activities within the HR department e.g. take calls, respond to candidate enquiries, supply information to care team
Produce management reports from Select HR system ready for Manager’s meetings
You will assist with aspects of recruitment, compiling and maintaining records training new and existing employees
Supporting any administration for projects
Person Specification
As an individual, you will be hardworking, reliable, IT literate, able to work to strict deadlines, and be a proactive team player. Your ability to carry out tasks with an employee retainment focused approach and organise your own workload whilst working towards tight deadlines are all skills required to succeed in this role.

As an HR Generalist you help create a productive work environment by designing, implementing and monitoring management’s employee development processes, programs and policies. You will be a natural conversationalist who understand how to balance company policies with employee needs.

Applicants should have at least a year’s experience working in a position that deals with employee management and employee/manager relationships. All candidates should be familiar with the role human resources policies within the organisation and in employment law.

Warm, friendly, and approachable manner; Can build and maintain excellent and credible relationships with managers and employees.

## **Das kannst du bewirken** ##
* Du betreust definierte Bereiche ganzheitlich und berätst Führungskräfte kompetent in sämtlichen operativen und strategischen HR-Themen.
* Als Sparring-Partner:in auf Augenhöhe unterstützt du bei Fragen rund um Führung, Zusammenarbeit, Organisation und Kultur.
* Anspruchsvolle Personalgespräche - von Konfliktsituationen bis hin zu Case Management - führst und begleitest du professionell und lösungsorientiert.
* Du bringst dich aktiv in HR-Projekte ein und setzt Impulse für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse und Instrumente.
* In Workshops und Sitzungen zu HR-Themen trittst du sicher auf, moderierst strukturiert und förderst den Dialog.
* Du bist erste Ansprechperson für unsere Berufsbildnerinnen und Berufsbildner: Du berätst sie fachlich, stärkst sie in ihrer Rolle und sorgst gemeinsam mit ihnen für eine qualitativ hochwertige Ausbildung.
* Unsere Lernenden begleitest du während ihrer Ausbildungszeit mit Feingefühl und Klarheit - auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen findest du tragfähige Lösungen.
## **Das bringst du mit** ##
* Du verfügst über einen HR-Fachausweis oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung und bringst rund 4-5 Jahre Erfahrung als HR Business Partner in einem ähnlichen Umfeld mit.
* Du bist eine umsetzungsstarke Persönlichkeit und arbeitest dich rasch in neue Themen ein.
* Mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, ausgeprägter Kommunikationsstärke und Engagement überzeugst du auf allen Ebenen.
* Du trittst souverän auf, bringst eine gesunde Portion Humor mit und verstehst es, Menschen zu begeistern.
* Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch, verfügst über sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse und fühlst dich auch bei gelegentlichen Gesprächen auf Englisch oder Französisch sicher.
* Ein vielseitiger Aufgabenbereich motiviert dich, du möchtest aktiv mitgestalten, Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltig etwas bewirken.
* Du hast von Vorteil Erfahrung in der Rekrutierung, Entwicklung und Begleitung von Lernenden - idealerweise in einem grösseren Unternehmen.
* Du hast Freude an der Arbeit mit jungen Menschen - und die nötige Standfestigkeit, auch in sensiblen Gesprächen klar, empathisch und lösungsorientiert zu handeln.
## **Das bieten wir dir** ##
**6 Wochen Ferien**

**Attraktive Pensionskasse mit flexiblen Sparplänen**

**Weiterbildung & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten**

**Individueller Entwicklungsplan**
Mit massgeschneiderten Entwicklungsplänen fördern wir gezielt deine individuellen Kompetenzen und unterstützen dein langfristiges Wachstum - ein zentraler Bestandteil unserer Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie. Erfahre mehr.

s.h: What you get to do in this role
s.t:
As an HR Business Partner for Global People, you are a business leader who specializes in how to build and manage high-performing teams. You'll immerse yourself in the business to understand what we're trying to achieve, then partner in delivering results through talent and workforce strategies that drive impact.
What sets this role apart is how you'll think about the future and the work itself. You'll rethink how we acquire, develop, and retain talent as AI fundamentally changes what work looks like — which means examining how work actually gets done, identifying inefficiencies, and redesigning operating models to close the gap between today and tomorrow. You'll help shape how Global People itself works and learns — the culture, practices, and capabilities that make transformation stick.
You will serve as an HRBP within Global People and have the opportunity to work across Corporate Functions:
Immerse in the business to understand strategic priorities and constraints. Partner with leaders to translate business goals into actionable talent and organizational strategies that drive measurable outcomes. Anticipate how an AI-forward org and evolving ways of working change the talent and capability needs.
Help shape the future of how an AI-enabled HR organization operates. Global People is architecting a transformational reinvention, and you have the rare opportunity to build from the ground up — establishing the culture, practices, and capabilities that will define how our function works and learns in an AI era.
Inspect how work actually gets done and redesign workflows and operating models. Identify inefficiencies and gaps. Work with leaders to close the distance between current state and future vision, considering both human roles and AI agent contributions.
Lead annual performance and development cycles — goal setting, talent reviews, calibrations, succession planning — with consistent and equitable execution. Use these moments to advance learning and upskilling in areas like AI literacy and modern operating models.
Use people data and operational data to surface risks and organizational effectiveness issues. Spot patterns in attrition, engagement, performance, and AI readiness; recommend targeted interventions.
Partner with Compensation, Benefits, Learning & Development, People Analytics, Talent Acquisition and other subject matter experts to design and deliver solutions that fit the business needs and scale appropriately.
Advise leaders on organizational design, team structures, roles, and operating models — especially as work evolves. Help them think through team structure and how responsibilities shift between humans and AI. Guide them through restructures, new processes, and scaling.
Support workforce planning by anticipating hiring needs, identifying and closing skill gaps, and building succession pipelines for critical roles. Think strategically about where AI agents augment or replace functions.
Drive culture and engagement initiatives across Global People: make sure people feel heard, managers have what they need, policies get applied consistently.
As you establish the model within Global People, you'll have the opportunity to scale these practices and partnerships across Corporate Functions.

s.h: To be successful in this role you have
s.t:
A business operator's mindset: you think and act like a business leader, not just a People specialist. You understand how organizational decisions impact business delivery and can navigate constraints and trade-offs.
You've led large-scale transformation — building operating models, redesigning processes, modernizing functions — by examining how work actually gets done. You can manage the gap between current state and future vision.
Strong ability to use data to benchmark performance, make informed decisions, and recommend solutions. You can read and interpret people analytics and operational metrics, and you spot patterns others miss.
Direct coaching and client support experience. You build trusted partnerships with leaders and help them navigate complexity. Experience working with business functions beyond HR is a plus.
Understanding of how AI is changing talent, work, and organization design — and a genuine passion for building learning-led cultures and enabling continuous upskilling. You can help leaders think through the implications for structure and capability.
Proven track record leading large-scale organizational or technology transformation. You navigate change and help it actually stick.
Ability to move fluidly across domains — strategic thinking, operational execution, organizational design, tactical problem-solving — and work effectively with multiple stakeholder groups.
Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills. You bring people together, build real relationships, and explain complex changes simply.
Comfort with ambiguity and independent work. You juggle complex issues, prioritize with limited guidance, and thrive in unstructured environments.
The confidence to challenge respectfully — to push back on ideas when it matters, ask hard questions, and influence decisions with data and clear thinking.
8+ years of professional experience in talent strategy, organizational effectiveness, or in relevant experience within the business.

vVARDIS is a Swiss\-based oral health company founded by Dr. Haleh and Dr. Golnar Abivardi, dentists, innovators, and award\-winning entrepreneurs. vVARDIS is the result of a combined 30 years of dental and entrepreneurial experience, and 20 years of laboratory and clinical research paired with the creative vision of its founders.
At vVARDIS, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that enhance oral health and well\-being, inspired by the vision of our founders to foster preventive rather than reparative dentistry. At the heart of our Company lies its patented, revolutionary biomimetic peptide technology.

Scientifically proven in over 200 publications, this unique technology can treat early caries through enamel regeneration, like no other technology can do, offering a non\-invasive, pain\-free solution for patients of all ages.

We offer a number of oral health products targeting dental professionals and their patients, as well as consumers, all based on our proprietary technology.
We value our people and believe in fostering a positive and collaborative work environment, based on our core values of innovation, excellence, integrity, and empathy.

We are seeking a hands\-on HR Generalist to support the Director Human Resources in the day\-to\-day HR operations across our EMEA markets, starting with Switzerland, the UK, and Italy, and expanding as the company grows.

This is a generalist role suited to someone who builds and improves processes rather than simply administering them — you'd rather fix a broken process than complain about it. You're comfortable holding direct, constructive conversations with managers when needed, while remaining approachable and collaborative.
The role also includes acting as payroll deputy for the UK, Switzerland, and Italy, ensuring continuity when the primary contact for our external payroll providers is unavailable. The role reports directly to the Director, Human Resources, with close day\-to\-day collaboration on HR and payroll matters. We work mostly from the office — 60% a week on site, 40% remote.

Payroll Deputy — UK, Switzerland \& Italy: Act as back\-up for payroll processing across the three countries, maintaining accurate documentation and liaising with external payroll providers and authorities as required.
HR Operations \& Process Building: Build and continuously improve core HR processes (onboarding, leave, records, policies) and maintain accurate, compliant personnel records across our EMEA locations. Some of this still needs to be built from the ground up — you're comfortable turning a blank page into a working process.
Employee Relations \& Manager Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and managers on HR matters, mediate disputes and handle grievances fairly, and promote a respectful, open workplace culture.
Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment: Manage end\-to\-end recruitment — job postings, sourcing, interviewing, offers, and onboarding — in close collaboration with hiring managers.
Performance Management: Run a simple, effective performance review process and coach managers on delivering direct, fair feedback.
Compensation \& Benefits: Support payroll processing with our external providers and administer employee benefits across EMEA, helping define pay structures that are fair, competitive, and easy to administer.
Compliance \& HR Best Practices: Ensure compliance with employment law across the UK, Switzerland, Italy, and other EMEA markets, escalating regulatory changes and labor law challenges to external counsel where needed.
Training \& Development: Organize onboarding and practical, ongoing learning support for employee development.

Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience.
3–5 years in an HR generalist or HR Manager role, ideally within a scale\-up or fast\-growing organization.
Practical knowledge of payroll and employment law fundamentals in at least one of the UK, Switzerland, or Italy — you don't need to be a lawyer or payroll specialist, but you know when to bring one in.
Proven ability to build and improve HR processes from the ground up.
A clear, calm communicator who remains professional and approachable, including in demanding situations.
Fluent in English and German and/or Italian an advantage given our presence in Switzerland and Italy.
Proficient with HR/payroll software and HRIS tools.

Job Description

People Operations is the operational engine of the People function at Cint.
Our mission is to build a scalable, intelligent and employee-centric operating model that enables the business to grow without increasing complexity. We achieve this by combining exceptional operational excellence with technology, automation and AI.
The way companies operate is changing rapidly. AI is transforming how work gets done, employees expect consumer-grade experiences, and global businesses need operations that scale without adding complexity. Most People Operations functions are still built for yesterday's world. We intend to build one for tomorrow.
This role will lead that transformation.
You will work closely with People Technology, Employee Relations, People Partners, Talent Teams, Total Rewards, Payroll, IT and Legal. You'll lead the evolution of our global People Operations function, combining operational excellence, technology, automation and AI to build a service that is fast, intelligent and ready for the future.

Build the People Operations function of the future: Redesign how People Operations works globally, creating an operating model that is simple, scalable and built to support a fast-growing international business.
Lead with technology, not manual work: Continuously identify opportunities to automate, simplify and redesign processes using AI, workflows and modern HR technology. If a process requires unnecessary manual effort, you'll challenge it.
Deliver service people actually love: Create an employee and manager experience that is intuitive, responsive and effortless. Great service isn't just about resolving tickets—it's about making support almost invisible.
Turn operations into a competitive advantage: Own service delivery globally through clear governance, operational controls and meaningful performance metrics that drive continuous improvement.
Lead and inspire a high-performing global team: Build a culture of accountability, ownership and innovation where people are empowered to solve problems, improve processes and think beyond today's way of working.
Partner across the business: Work closely with HR, People Technology, IT, Finance, Legal and business leaders to solve operational challenges, deliver complex initiatives and create joined-up employee experiences.
Use data, but apply judgement: Leverage operational metrics and workforce insights to identify trends, predict risks and make better decisions—while recognising that dashboards never replace critical thinking.
Own complexity so others don't have to: Act as the senior escalation point for complex People Operations matters, balancing compliance, employee experience and business priorities with sound judgement.
Build for scale before it's needed: Design resilient operations that support organisational growth, new markets and changing business needs without constantly adding more people or processes.
Never stop improving: Constantly ask why things are done a certain way, challenge existing assumptions and build a culture where continuous improvement is simply how work gets done.
